title: In Small Iranian Town, a U.S. Attack Turns a Wedding Into a Tragedy
summary_full: The bomb that hit the residential area was American, according to a weapons expert and a visual analysis by The Times. It killed five people and wounded 67 others, the Iranian authorities said.
